# RFC 2578 section 7.9 writes an OBJECT IDENTIFIER default as a single
# descriptor naming an already-registered node. This fixture writes the
# sub-identifier list at one brace level, where DEFVAL's own braces are
# the only ones there are.
#
# The doubled-brace spelling next door is the same deviation nested one
# level deeper. Both have to be graded, because a reader that takes the
# first number for an integer default returns 1 where the source said
# 1.3.6.1 and says nothing about the difference.
code smi/non-conforming-oid-default
